Create a genuinely NEW native basiccombat pixel-art spriteatlas. Monsoon from MAINSTORY2013 MetalGearRisingRevengeance, tall slim cyborgman, dark charcoal/red segmented mechanicalbody, many clean circular modulararm/leg/torso joints, red accents and deepredleftarm, palehumanlowerface withsmirk. Distinctive RED HELMET with dark horizontal VISOR overeyes and long silver/palehair trailingfromback ofhelmet; no bareRaidenface/white spikyRagnahair, no metaljaw or eyepatch. TWO real three-pronged SAI named DYSTOPIA, oneheldineachhand; not katanas/guns. Magneticmodularbody can separate cleanrobotsegments with small gaps, still controllably connected aswhole, no blood/flesh/wounds, no organic severing. Red-phosphorus/smokepouches atbelt. Power = electromagnetism moving INORGANIC METALDEBRIS and cleanrobotsegmentdodge, never writtenmemes or magicalletters.
Match the attached NEW2013 presentation identity, not the old missing/wrongequipment. Draw exactlyFOUR columns FOUR rows =16 fullbody nativeposes on idealsquare1024x1024 transparentcanvas. Equal invisiblecells with bigtransparentgaps; every completebody/weapon/attachedarm/tail/foot staysinsideitscell with clearspace allaround. No text/grid/ground/scenery/logo. Crisp detailed pixelart samecharacterproportions/costume. Do NOT reuse/repeat/rotate/mirror referencecells. Everyanatomicalpose newlydrawn anddifferent. Combatdirectionimage-right. No victims,blood,gore ororganic severing. Modularrobotjoints may separate cleanly onlywhere the characterusesit, never fleshcutting. Do not shrink a bodyforoverwideVFX; keepweaponscompact.
ROW1 IDLE:4 visiblydifferent breathing/weightshift drawings, hands/shoulders/knees orquadrupedhead/legsadjust, weaponatguard.
ROW2 RUN:4 chronologicaltrue strides with alternatingfeet/limbs, torsoangles andweaponcarriagechanges. BladeWolf staysFOUR-LEGGED mechanicalquadruped in all4, not runninghuman.
ROW3 ATTACK fourtimings: guardwithtwoDystopiasai, compact one-saiwindup, torso-twist physicalsai cut inclosecontact, recover pairedsaiguard. No debris ormagneticrangedattack on basics, no gun/sword or magicmemes.
ROW4 HIT:4 non-gory recoil/recovery poses: absorbbackwardlean, bracebentknees/quadlegs, cautiouslowguard, returnguard. Allfullbodieshead-tofeetvisibleevenlowposes. Armstrong alwaysbarechest/darktrousers; Monsoon alwaysredhelmet/blackvisor/silverhair/twosai; Sam redkatana/exosuit/humanface; Mistralattachedrobotarmsandjointedstaff; Wolffourlegsandtailchainsaw. All16distinctnativecells; projectadaptation, not officialsourcegameframes/1:1claim.

entries.characterVersion: BladeWolf LQ-84i from MetalGearRisingRevengeance2013, mechanical QUADRUPED robotic wolf. Dark graphite/black segmented metalchassis, silver mechanical dorsal neck/spine plates, long angular mechanical canid muzzle, pointed sensors/ears and yellow/orange optical sensors, articulated clawed FOUR legs. Not a furry realanimal, no humanoid chest/arms or dog costume. His long jointed MANIPULATOR TAIL grips/controls one real highfrequency CHAINSAW with visible toothed cuttingchain; the chainsaw is held by the tail gripper rather than turning his whole tail into a vague glowing blade. It can rest compactly along his back while walking. All four leg limbs remain readable; no biped human stance.

entries.characterVersion: SamuelRodrigues, JetstreamSam, MAINSTORY2013 MetalGearRisingRevengeance duel version. Adult muscular Brazilian swordsman, tan human face, darkbrown hair tied in short samurai ponytail/chonmage, facialstubble, brown eyes, confident grin. Gray/bronze powered exoskeleton with dark underlayers and red shoulder accents, anatomical RIGHT cybernetic arm, otherwise human wearing suit, not Raiden's fullymetal skull/jaw. NO whitehair or cyborgjaw, no eyepatch. One real red-bladed highfrequency katana MURASAMA, compactblack/red poweredSCABBARD on left hip with trigger/receiver mechanism that launches the draw. Left hand holds scabbard/trigger, right hand draws/cuts with katana; exactly one blade, not duplicate swords. No separate firearm in his hands: the scabbard mechanism powers the draw, not a shootinggun.
